content: पुस्तकः, -कम् .²1 A book, manuscript. .²2 A protuberant ornament, boss. .{@-आगारम्@} a library. .{@-आस्तरणम्@} The wrapper of a manuscript; <ls>Hch.</ls> .{@-मुद्रा@} a kind of mudrā mentioned in Tantraśāstra; वाममुष्टिं स्वाभिमुखीं कृत्वा पुस्तकमुद्रिका. .{@-पुस्तिकापूलिकः@} a collection of manuscripts; <ls>Hch. 3</ls>.
